description: Search ShopSavvy's published 'best of' buying guides (for example 'gaming laptop' or 'wireless earbuds') and return each guide's ranked picks with a short reason and a link to the full guide on shopsavvy.com. Use it for category research, then check current prices with product_offers. Free without an API key; with a key, 1 credit per guide returned (minimum 1). If no guide matches, say so; do not invent picks.
